pay_salary_schedule_001.evidence: Effective July 1, 2013, the 2012-2013 Teachers’ Salary Schedule will be substituted and replaced with a new 2013-2014 Salary Schedule as set forth in Appendix A of this Agreement.

pay_salary_schedule_002.evidence: Effective July 1, 2013, the 2012-2013 Teachers’ Salary Schedule will be substituted and replaced with a new 2013-2014 Salary Schedule as set forth in Appendix A of this Agreement.

pay_step_increment_003.evidence: The Parties agree that employees on a step salary schedule will be eligible for a step increment at the beginning of the school year; however, the step increment will not be implemented until the value of the step has been determined through negotiations.

pay_prior_experience_005.evidence: each new employee’s verified prior years of public and/or private school successful teaching experience not to exceed 25 years, will be recognized by the District as provided herein... Employees must submit verification within ninety (90) days of the beginning date of regular paid employment with the District in order to receive experience credit.

pay_performance_pay_006.evidence: all employees... who are full-time or half-time employees of the District on the date this Agreement is adopted by the School Board who were evaluated as either “Effective” or “Highly Effective” on their 2012-2013 annual evaluations will receive a Performance Pay increase

pay_performance_pay_007.answer: Eligibility is determined by annual evaluation ratings, specifically requiring a rating of “Effective” or “Highly Effective” on their 2012-2013 annual evaluations. New employees or those returning from a leave of absence are automatically considered to have received an “Effective” rating.
pay_performance_pay_007.evidence: who were evaluated as either “Effective” or “Highly Effective” on their 2012-2013 annual evaluations will receive a Performance Pay increase as provided in paragraph 1 a above. Full-time or half-time employees who are either new to the District or returning from a leave of absence also will be considered to have been provided a rating of “Effective” on their annual evaluations for 2012-2013.
